roofs_directional.note: writes saturated (+1.3% over the 48->64 MB step); reads still creeping (+2.3%), so 388.3 is a floor. 435.3 previously quoted by the fleet is a mixed read+write aggregate, not a directional roof.

models.overlapped: T_dram = max(T_l1, bytes/BW_eff), delta -> 0 as compute grows

overlap_discriminator_ksweep.verdict: compute grows 8.9x, delta flat. overlapped model dead, serialized model confirmed.
